# STATUS KAY

> STATUS KAY is a hair and nail salon in the center of Ljubljana, Slovenia, across the street from the main train station and 100 m from the main bus station. Services include haircuts, balayage, blonding, colour correction, blow-dry styling, and nail care. The site is bilingual (Slovenian and English), with paths prefixed `/sl/` and `/en/`.

## Pages

- [Home (EN)](https://www.statuskay.com/en): Salon overview and highlights.
- [Home (SL)](https://www.statuskay.com/sl): Pregled salona v slovenščini.
- [Services (EN)](https://www.statuskay.com/en/services): Full list of hair and nail services.
- [Storitve (SL)](https://www.statuskay.com/sl/storitve): Seznam storitev za lase in nohte.
- [About (EN)](https://www.statuskay.com/en/about): Salon story and team.
- [O nas (SL)](https://www.statuskay.com/sl/o-nas): Zgodba salona in ekipa.
- [Blog (EN)](https://www.statuskay.com/en/blog): Hair and nail care articles.
- [Blog (SL)](https://www.statuskay.com/sl/blog): Članki o negi las in nohtov.
- [How to Get Here (EN)](https://www.statuskay.com/en/directions): Directions and transit info.
- [Kako do nas (SL)](https://www.statuskay.com/sl/kako-do-nas): Navodila za pot do salona.
- [Contact (EN)](https://www.statuskay.com/en/contact): Contact form and salon details.
- [Kontakt (SL)](https://www.statuskay.com/sl/kontakt): Kontaktni obrazec in podatki salona.
